name: Crispy tofu & broccoli stir-fry
steps: Press the tofu, cube it, and toss with cornflour and a pinch of salt.
Pan-fry the tofu in hot oil until golden and crisp on all sides.
Add the broccoli and a splash of water, then cover and steam for two minutes.
Stir through the soy sauce and garlic and toss until glossy.
